_note: FL11 hand analysis, read by fl11_build.mjs (which joins it with the computed sites, ROM offsets and event-block rectangles). Keys are the event-block index n in hex (flag = $0100 + n). 'spine' entries become proposals (the index is touched by more than one scene group), the others become full records. Death-action flags with no entry here get the generic record built from the scene_actors row.
